title: Towards Feedback-to-Plan Decisions for Self-Evolving LLM Agents in CUDA Kernel Generation
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong empirical gains as self-evolving agents for CUDA kernel generation, driven by feedback-conditioned planning across generations. However, how planning decisions attribute and combine heterogeneous feedback signals remains opaque. Standard end-to-end ablations fail to resolve this question, as iterative planning amplifies early perturbations and conflates feedback effects with trajectory-dependent drift.
  We introduce \texttt{CUDAnalyst}, a unified analysis layer for controlled, generation-level attribution of planning decisions to feedback components via trajectory freezing and selective feedback injection. \texttt{CUDAnalyst} enables stable generation-level evaluation and principled coalitional-style attribution of feedback effects and interactions. Our results show that explicit planning is beneficial only when feedback is aligned, that effective planning emerges from structured multi-feedback interactions, and that high-level plans from stronger reasoning models can partially transfer to weaker ones. These trends hold across reference backbones, representative workloads, and reference induction regimes, indicating that the identified feedback-to-plan structure is robust within the controlled axes studied.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CUDAnalyst，一种用于分析LLM在CUDA内核生成中反馈与规划决策归因的统一分析框架，通过轨迹冻结和选择性反馈注入实现稳定的生成级评估。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM作为自进化智能体生成CUDA内核时，规划决策如何归因于不同反馈信号（如编译错误、性能指标）及其交互作用尚不透明。标准端到端消融实验因迭代规划放大早期扰动，无法区分反馈效应与轨迹漂移。
AI.method: 提出CUDAnalyst框架，核心方法包括：(1) 轨迹冻结（trajectory freezing），固定中间生成步骤以隔离反馈效应；(2) 选择性反馈注入（selective feedback injection），控制不同反馈组件的接入；(3) 基于联盟博弈理论的归因分析，量化反馈组件的主效应和交互效应。
AI.result: (1) 显式规划仅在反馈对齐时有益；(2) 有效规划源于结构化多反馈交互；(3) 强推理模型的高层计划可部分迁移至弱模型。这些趋势在多个参考骨干网络、代表性工作负载和归纳条件下稳定成立。
AI.conclusion: CUDAnalyst揭示了反馈到规划的稳定结构关系，为理解LLM智能体中的反馈归因提供了方法论基础，并揭示了规划与反馈对齐的重要性。
idea_en: A method for controlled attribution of planning decisions to feedback components in LLM-based code generation using trajectory freezing, where intermediate generation steps are fixed to isolate the effect of specific feedback signals on subsequent planning decisions.

A selective feedback injection system for large language models that enables coalitional-style attribution analysis by controlling which heterogeneous feedback signals (e.g., compilation errors, performance metrics) are provided to the model during CUDA kernel generation.

A technique for transferring high-level planning strategies from stronger reasoning models to weaker ones in code generation tasks, enabling knowledge distillation of planning capabilities across models of different capacities.
A unified analysis framework for evaluating how multi-feedback interactions contribute to planning quality in iterative self-evolving agent systems, using game-theoretic attribution principles.
idea_ch: 基于轨迹冻结的LLM代码生成中规划决策归因方法：通过固定中间生成步骤，隔离特定反馈信号对后续规划决策的影响，实现反馈组件的可控归因分析。

跨模型规划策略迁移技术：将强推理模型的高层规划策略部分迁移至弱推理模型，实现代码生成任务中规划能力的知识蒸馏。

title: It's Not the Capability: Harness Sensitivity Is Non-Monotone Across LLM Agent Tiers
summary:
A prevalent assumption in LLM agent deployment holds that more structured harnesses universally improve
  reliability, and that higher-capability models need proportionally less structural guidance -- together
  implying a monotone inverse relationship between model capability tier and optimal harness complexity. We
  test this hypothesis through a controlled 432-run experiment crossing six models across four capability
  tiers with three harness conditions (light, balanced, strict) on HEAT-24, a 24-task synthetic benchmark
  with git-based workspace verification. Our results refute the monotone inverse relationship on two
  fronts. First, for the frontier chat model evaluated (Gemini 2.5 Flash), increased harness verbosity
  lowers VTSR by 29-38 percentage points -- a harness-complexity paradox. Second, for the frontier
  reasoning model evaluated (Qwen3.5-122B, extended thinking enabled), strict harness achieves the highest
  VTSR (91.7%) and the lowest latency, the opposite of the prediction. Within the constrained tier, a 2B
  model (Gemma4:e2B) matches strong-open-tier stability at 91.7% across all harnesses. Because each tier is
  represented by a single model in this study, these results should be interpreted as model-specific
  observations; harness sensitivity appears non-monotone across the models evaluated, and depends
  critically on model type (chat vs. reasoning). We introduce a six-label failure taxonomy showing that
  format_violation dominates capable-model failures while wrong_file dominates low-capability failures, and
  we derive practical tier-aware harness selection guidelines.

AI.tldr: 本文通过432次实验，测试了LLM agent部署中"模型能力越强，所需结构化约束越少"的假设。结果否定了这一单调逆关系：对于前沿聊天模型，增加约束反而降低性能（29-38个百分点）；对于推理模型，严格约束达到最佳效果；而2B小模型在所有约束条件下表现稳定。研究还提出了六标签故障分类法和分层约束选择指南。
AI.motivation: 验证LLM agent部署中一个普遍假设：更结构化的约束普遍提高可靠性，且能力更强的模型需要的结构引导更少——即模型能力等级与最优约束复杂度之间存在单调逆关系。
AI.method: 在HEAT-24基准上，对4个能力层级的6个模型，在3种约束条件（宽松、平衡、严格）下进行了432次受控实验，使用基于git的工作区验证。
AI.result: 否定了单调逆关系：1）Gemini 2.5 Flash（聊天模型）中增加约束使VTSR降低29-38个百分点（约束复杂度悖论）；2）Qwen3.5-122B（推理模型）中严格约束达到最高VTSR（91.7%）和最低延迟；3）2B模型在所有约束条件下表现稳定（91.7%）。
AI.conclusion: 约束敏感性是非单调的，关键取决于模型类型（聊天vs推理），不能简单假设能力越强所需约束越少。提出了六标签故障分类法（格式违规主导高能力模型故障，错误文件主导低能力故障）和分层约束选择指南。
idea_en: A dynamic harness complexity adjustment system for LLM agents that automatically adapts structural constraints based on real-time model type classification (chat vs. reasoning) and observed failure patterns, rather than using a fixed harness level.

A tier-aware harness selection method that applies strictest structural constraints to reasoning models while applying lighter constraints to chat models, optimized for both task success rate and latency reduction.

A six-label failure taxonomy system for LLM agent execution that categorizes failures into format_violation, wrong_file, and four other types, enabling targeted harness optimization based on failure pattern analysis.
A git-based workspace verification method for LLM agent benchmarks that provides deterministic validation of agent task completion without relying on LLM-as-judge evaluation.
idea_ch: 一种用于LLM agent的动态约束复杂度自适应调整系统，根据实时模型类型分类（聊天vs推理）和观察到的故障模式自动调整结构约束，而非使用固定约束级别。
一种分层感知的约束选择方法，对推理模型应用最严格的结构约束，对聊天模型应用较宽松约束，同时优化任务成功率和延迟。

title: A Dataset of Robot-Patient and Doctor-Patient Medical Dialogues for Spoken Language Processing Tasks
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have brought huge improvements to Artificial Intelligence (AI), which can be applied to general-purpose tasks. However, their application to textual or spoken medical consultations is still an open research problem. This paper proposes MeDial-Speech, a novel speech dataset for training and evaluating Med-AIs that can carry out consultations with patients. It was collected in realistic environments from robot-patient and doctor-patient dialogues, contains 111+ hours of speech data (without data augmentation), and covers four health conditions: Lewy body dementia, heart failure, shoulder pain, and angina. In addition, we propose a dialogue benchmark via sentence selection (with 20 options) to evaluate three state-of-the-art LLMs: GPT-5 mini, DeepSeek-V3, and Claude Sonnet 4. Experimental results reveal that Claude Sonnet 4 is the best in sentence selection, with 71.1% accuracy using manual transcriptions and 74.7% using automatic transcriptions, and that all LLMs are highly overconfident in their probabilistic predictions, regardless of selecting correct or incorrect sentences in medical dialogues. This dataset is free of charge for non-commercial purposes at: https://huggingface.co/datasets/hcuayahu/MeDial-Speech

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MeDial-Speech，一个用于训练和评估医疗AI的语音对话数据集，包含111+小时的真实医患对话数据，覆盖四种健康状态，并构建了基于句子选择的对话基准来评估三个最新LLMs（GPT-5 mini、DeepSeek-V3、Claude Sonnet 4）。实验发现Claude Sonnet 4在句子选择任务中表现最佳（准确率71.1%-74.7%），但所有LLM在概率预测上都高度过度自信。
AI.motivation: LLMs在通用任务上表现出色，但在医疗咨询这一实际应用场景中仍面临挑战，缺乏专门用于训练和评估医疗AI的语音对话数据集。
AI.method: 收集了机器人-患者和医生-患者两种场景下的真实对话语音数据，构建了111+小时、覆盖四种健康状态的数据集，并设计了基于20选1句子选择的对话基准评估方法。
AI.result: Claude Sonnet 4在句子选择任务中准确率最高（手动转录71.1%，自动转录74.7%），所有LLM均表现出高度的概率预测过度自信。
AI.conclusion: MeDial-Speech数据集可有效支持医疗AI的语音对话训练与评估，但现有LLM在医疗对话中的置信度校准问题仍需解决。
idea_en: A speech dataset (MeDial-Speech) collected from realistic robot-patient and doctor-patient dialogues for training medical AI consultation systems.
A dialogue benchmark method via sentence selection with 20 options for evaluating LLMs in medical consultation dialogues.
A cross-LLM evaluation framework comparing GPT-5 mini, DeepSeek-V3, and Claude Sonnet 4 on medical dialogue sentence selection tasks.
An approach to assess LLM confidence calibration in medical dialogues by analyzing probabilistic predictions versus actual correctness.
idea_ch: 一种从机器人-患者和医生-患者真实对话场景中收集的医疗语音数据集（MeDial-Speech），用于训练医疗AI咨询系统。
一种基于20选1句子选择的对话基准评估方法，用于评估LLM在医疗咨询对话中的表现。
一种跨LLM评估框架，可同时比较GPT-5 mini、DeepSeek-V3和Claude Sonnet 4在医疗对话句子选择任务上的性能。
一种通过分析概率预测与实际正确性之间的差异来评估LLM在医疗对话中置信度校准程度的方法。

title: Beyond a Single Direction: Chain-of-Thought Disrupts Simple Steering of Refusal
summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) generate chain-of-thought (CoT) traces before producing final outputs, introducing a dynamic internal state that may complicate control mechanisms such as refusal. Unlike instruction-tuned LLMs, where refusal is mediated by a single directional subspace, refusal in large reasoning models (LRMs) additionally depends on the CoT. In DeepSeek-R1-Distill-LLaMA-8B, activation steering reverses refusal in only 39% of cases when the CoT is kept fixed, but removing the CoT entirely increases this to 70%, indicating that the CoT actively reinforces refusal. In a two-stage intervention where the model regenerates its CoT under activation steering, refusal is reversed in 94% of cases, while the resulting CoT alone retains 48% of this effect even after steering is removed. This suggests that the CoT can carry and reconstruct the compliance signal independently. These findings indicate that refusal in LRMs is jointly encoded in residual stream activations and CoT. This joint activation makes LRM more robust against activation-level interventions alone, but exposes CoT to a possible alternative surface attack.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大型推理模型（LRMs）中的拒绝机制，发现其不仅依赖于残差流激活，还依赖于思维链（CoT）。思维链本身可以独立携带并重构合规信号，使得仅针对激活层的干预效果有限，但暴露出CoT可能成为新的攻击面。
AI.motivation: 探索大型推理模型（LRMs）中拒绝机制的运作方式，特别是思维链（CoT）在其中的作用，以及传统的激活层干预方法在LRMs中的有效性。
AI.method: 使用DeepSeek-R1-Distill-LLaMA-8B模型进行三组对比实验：(1)固定CoT仅做激活导向；(2)移除CoT后做激活导向；(3)两阶段干预：先激活导向，让模型重新生成CoT，再移除激活导向仅保留新CoT。
AI.result: 固定CoT时激活导向仅39%成功；移除CoT后成功率升至70%；两阶段干预（激活导向+重新生成CoT）成功率达94%，且新生成的CoT单独保留48%的效果。
AI.conclusion: LRMs中的拒绝机制由残差流激活和CoT共同编码，这种联合编码方式使得模型对激活层干预更具鲁棒性，但CoT本身成为潜在的替代攻击面。
idea_en: A two-stage intervention method for reversing refusal in large reasoning models: applying activation steering during chain-of-thought regeneration, then removing steering while retaining the modified CoT to propagate compliance signals.

A method for controlling model refusal behavior via chain-of-thought modification alone, independent of residual stream activation steering, demonstrating that CoT can carry and reconstruct compliance signals.

A joint encoding mechanism for refusal in large reasoning models, where refusal decisions are distributed across both residual stream activations and chain-of-thought traces, creating dual-pathway control.

A technique for generating compliant outputs from refusing models by first steering activations during CoT generation, then extracting and reusing the modified CoT as an independent intervention vector.

An attack surface identification method targeting chain-of-thought traces in reasoning models, where CoT is exploited as an alternative pathway to bypass refusal mechanisms without modifying model weights or activations.
idea_ch: 一种用于逆转大型推理模型拒绝行为的两阶段干预方法：在思维链重新生成过程中施加激活导向，然后移除导向但保留修改后的思维链，使其独立传播合规信号。
一种仅通过修改思维链即可控制模型拒绝行为的方法，独立于残差流激活导向，证明思维链能够独立携带并重构合规信号。
一种大型推理模型中拒绝行为的联合编码机制，将拒绝决策分布在残差流激活和思维链两条路径上，形成双路径控制。
一种通过先在思维链生成时进行激活导向，然后提取并使用修改后的思维链作为独立干预向量，从拒绝模型生成合规输出的技术。
一种针对推理模型思维链的攻击面识别方法，将思维链作为绕过拒绝机制的替代途径，无需修改模型权重或激活层。

title: The Attribution Blind Spot: Detecting When Language Models Rely on Memory Rather Than Retrieved Context
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation promises to ground language model outputs in external evidence, yet the field has no reliable way to verify whether retrieved context actually governs generation -- a prerequisite for any high-stakes deployment. The standard assumption, that context-consistent output implies context-governed output, breaks when the retrieved document overlaps with the model's pretraining data: the model can produce faithful-looking text entirely from parametric memory, and both pathways yield indistinguishable output. We name this failure the attribution blind spot and introduce Computational Reality Monitoring (CRM) to address it. CRM operationalizes a principle adapted from cognitive science's reality monitoring framework: comparing internal representations with and without context reveals membership-conditioned representational divergence that output-level monitors systematically miss. CRM does not certify which source an individual generation used; it detects whether pretraining exposure leaves a measurable internal trajectory signature, establishing a necessary substrate for source attribution. Across nine model variants spanning three families, this divergence concentrates in architecture-specific layer patterns, receives converging support from block-level noise intervention, and generalizes across tasks and datasets while collapsing on domain-confounded benchmarks. The attribution blind spot is measurable and partially addressable: internal representations carry a diagnostic signal invisible at the output level, establishing a foundation for systems whose internal awareness of evidence provenance governs their external behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文发现检索增强生成（RAG）存在“归因盲点”：当检索文档与模型预训练数据重叠时，无法区分输出是来自检索上下文还是模型参数记忆。为此提出计算现实监控（CRM），通过比较有/无上下文时模型内部表征的差异，检测预训练暴露留下的内部轨迹信号，从而建立溯源归因的基础。
AI.motivation: RAG领域缺乏可靠方法验证检索到的上下文是否真正控制了生成过程，现有假设（上下文一致的输出即上下文驱动的输出）在检索文档与预训练数据重叠时失效，导致归因盲点。
AI.method: 借鉴认知科学的现实监控框架，通过对比有上下文和无上下文条件下模型内部表征的差异，检测因预训练暴露而产生的成员条件性表征分歧，该信号在输出层面无法被观测。
AI.result: 在9个模型变体（3个系列）上验证：表征分歧集中在特定架构的层模式中，得到块级噪声干预的收敛支持，在任务和数据集间具有泛化性，但在领域混淆的基准上失效。
AI.conclusion: 归因盲点可测量且可部分解决：内部表征携带着输出层面不可见的诊断信号，为构建能够感知证据来源的内部意识系统奠定基础。
idea_en: A method for detecting whether a language model's generation is governed by retrieved context or parametric memory by comparing internal representations under context-present vs. context-absent conditions.
A computational reality monitoring (CRM) system that operationalizes cognitive science's reality monitoring framework for LLMs to detect membership-conditioned representational divergence.
A block-level noise intervention technique that probes model internal representations to confirm whether output is context-driven or memory-driven.
An attribution blind spot detection mechanism that identifies when retrieved documents overlap with pretraining data, causing indistinguishable output pathways.
idea_ch: 一种通过比较有/无上下文条件下模型内部表征差异，检测语言模型生成结果是由检索上下文还是参数记忆主导的方法
一种将认知科学现实监控框架操作化为LLM计算现实监控（CRM）系统，用于检测成员条件性表征分歧的技术
一种块级噪声干预技术，通过探测模型内部表征来确认输出是由上下文驱动还是记忆驱动
一种归因盲点检测机制，用于识别检索文档与预训练数据重叠时导致的输出路径不可区分问题

title: LiveK12Bench: Have Large Multimodal Models Truly Conquered High School-level Examinations?
summary: Advanced Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) have demonstrated impressive performance in K-12 reasoning tasks, exhibiting great promise as intelligent tutors. Realizing this potential requires models to navigate real-world examinations effectively, yet most existing benchmarks fail to capture the complexity of authentic testing environments. Specifically, most datasets are static, prone to data contamination, and are often confined to restricted modalities, disciplines, and evaluation criteria. To address these issues, we introduce LiveK12Bench, a dynamic, holistic, multi-disciplinary benchmark designed to evaluate the reasoning abilities of LMMs in realistic examination scenarios. LiveK12Bench comprises 2K+ verified questions spanning Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, and Biology, sourced from the latest real-world exam papers and designed to grow over time. Our framework features several core innovations: 1) featuring an automated pipeline that continuously ingests and parses the latest examination papers to mitigate data leakage; and 2) proposing a novel `Mock Exam' evaluation scheme, which assesses the ability to complete end-to-end exams autonomously with accurate and efficient reasoning paths. Extensive experiments on 12 LMMs reveal that advanced models suffer substantial performance degradation under exam-realistic constraints: GPT-5's score drops from 79 to 53 (out of 100) when process rigor and efficiency are jointly evaluated. Our findings expose critical vulnerabilities, such as sensitivity to complex visual layouts, highlighting the gap between idealized reasoning capabilities and true educational readiness. Both code and dataset are publicly available.

AI.tldr: LiveK12Bench是一个动态、全面的多学科基准测试，用于评估大型多模态模型在真实K-12考试场景中的推理能力，包含2000+实时验证题目，并提出"模拟考试"评估方案。实验表明，在考试真实约束下，先进模型（如GPT-5）性能从79分大幅下降至53分。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试存在静态性、易受数据污染、模态/学科/评估标准受限等问题，无法真实反映LMMs在真实考试环境中的表现，迫切需要更贴近实际教育场景的动态评估框架。
AI.method: 1) 构建自动化管道持续摄入和解析最新考卷以缓解数据泄露；2) 提出"模拟考试"评估方案，评估模型端到端自主完成考试的能力，同时考虑推理路径的准确性和效率；3) 涵盖数学、物理、化学、生物四个学科，题目来自真实世界最新试卷，随时间动态增长。
AI.result: 对12个LMMs的广泛实验表明，在考试真实约束下，先进模型性能大幅下降：GPT-5从79分降至53分（满分100）。模型对复杂视觉布局敏感等关键脆弱性被揭示。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了理想化推理能力与真实教育准备度之间的差距，强调了评估框架需更贴近真实考试场景才能准确衡量LMMs作为智能导师的潜力。
idea_en: 1. Automated pipeline for continuous ingestion and parsing of latest examination papers to mitigate data leakage in multimodal model evaluation.
2. Mock Exam evaluation scheme that assesses end-to-end autonomous exam completion with joint evaluation of reasoning path accuracy and efficiency.
3. Dynamic, multi-disciplinary benchmark framework (LiveK12Bench) with 2000+ verified questions spanning Math, Physics, Chemistry, Biology that grows over time.
4. Method for exposing model vulnerabilities to complex visual layouts in real examination scenarios through exam-realistic constraint evaluation.
idea_ch: 1. 自动化考卷摄入与解析管道：持续从最新真实试卷中摄入数据并自动解析，有效缓解多模态模型评估中的数据泄露问题。
2. 模拟考试评估方案：提出端到端自主完成考试的评价机制，同时考核推理路径的准确性和效率，更真实反映模型的教育应用能力。
3. 动态多学科基准框架（LiveK12Bench）：包含2000+经过验证的跨学科试题（数学、物理、化学、生物），随考试周期动态增长。
4. 考试真实约束下的视觉鲁棒性评估方法：通过引入真实考试中复杂视觉布局约束，揭示模型在视觉理解方面的脆弱性。

title: Composition Collapse: Stable Factual Knowledge Does Not Imply Compositional Reasoning
summary: Post-training is routinely evaluated through aggregate benchmark scores that treat multi-hop reasoning as a single capability -- as if a model that answers more questions correctly must be better at assembling facts. We show that this assumption can be misleading: recipes with statistically indistinguishable atomic knowledge produce composition behaviour separated by over 40 percentage points, a phenomenon we call composition collapse: the systematic failure to assemble stably-known facts into chains, invisible to aggregate metrics. We introduce a double-gate protocol that changes the estimand from an aggregate compositionality gap to residual composition failure conditioned on stable atomic access, decomposing post-training gains into three independent channels: atomic stability, residual composition, and critical depth. On a benchmark of temporal factual chains spanning depths 2--11 across four post-training recipes, this decomposition reveals that post-training objectives shift composition capability in directions that aggregate metrics mask, and suggests that claims about multi-hop reasoning improvement should be accompanied by atomic-gate-controlled composition metrics. Diagnostic probes further show that a substantial share of measured composition failure reflects generation-time computation constraints rather than permanent inability to compose.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了一个被称为"组合崩溃"（composition collapse）的现象：模型在原子知识稳定掌握的情况下，仍会在组合多跳推理时系统性失败，而传统聚合指标掩盖了这一问题。作者提出了一种双门控协议（double-gate protocol），将组合能力分解为原子稳定性、残差组合和关键深度三个独立通道，并在时序事实链基准上验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统后训练评估通过聚合基准分数来衡量多跳推理能力，错误地将"答对更多问题"等同于"更好地组合事实"。作者发现，在原子知识水平统计无显著差异的情况下，组合行为差距可超过40个百分点，表明聚合指标存在严重误导性。
AI.method: 提出双门控协议（double-gate protocol），将评估目标从聚合的组合性差距（aggregate compositionality gap）转变为在稳定原子访问条件下的残差组合失败（residual composition failure），将后训练增益分解为三个独立通道：原子稳定性（atomic stability）、残差组合（residual composition）和关键深度（critical depth）。
AI.result: 在跨越深度2-11的时序事实链基准上，对四种后训练方案进行分解，发现后训练目标以聚合指标掩盖的方式改变组合能力方向。诊断探针进一步表明，相当一部分组合失败源于生成时的计算约束，而非永久性的组合能力缺失。
AI.conclusion: 关于多跳推理能力提升的结论应附带原子门控控制的组合度量指标，以真实反映模型的组合推理能力。
idea_en: A double-gate protocol for evaluating multi-hop reasoning that decomposes post-training gains into atomic stability, residual composition, and critical depth channels, enabling separation of atomic knowledge access from composition failure.

A method to detect composition collapse by comparing models with statistically indistinguishable atomic knowledge but divergent composition behavior, with a diagnostic threshold of over 40 percentage points gap.
Diagnostic probes that identify generation-time computation constraints as a separable factor from permanent inability to compose, allowing targeted optimization of inference-time resources.
A benchmark of temporal factual chains spanning depths 2-11 for systematic evaluation of multi-hop reasoning under controlled atomic knowledge conditions.
idea_ch: 一种用于评估多跳推理的双门控协议，将后训练增益分解为原子稳定性、残差组合和关键深度三个通道，能够将原子知识访问与组合失败分离评估
一种检测组合崩溃的方法，通过比较原子知识统计无差异但组合行为差异超过40个百分点的模型，识别聚合指标掩盖的组合能力缺陷
诊断探针技术，可区分生成时计算约束导致的组合失败与永久性组合能力缺失，从而针对性地优化推理资源分配
一种涵盖深度2-11的时序事实链基准数据集，用于在受控原子知识条件下系统评估多跳推理能力

title: What Makes Chain-of-Thought Work at Probe Time? Local Co-occurrence Rather Than Global Derivation
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting reliably improves language-model accuracy, but which properties of a rationale text drive the improvement is poorly understood. Prior work has largely studied generation-time behavior. We instead ask a probe-time question: given a fixed rationale in context, what in that text changes the answer? We identify two complementary sources of the gain. First, even a globally word-shuffled rationale substantially outperforms the no-rationale baseline, indicating a strong lexical activation effect. More importantly, the additional gain from structured text appears to arise less from sentence-level logical ordering and more from short-range token adjacency. Preserving contiguous windows of just $n^\star{=}2$--$3$ tokens recovers most of the remaining gain toward full CoT performance. Supporting experiments rule out copying of explicit answer declarations or answer values, as well as full grammatical realization, as primary drivers. Further generalization experiments show that the qualitative pattern remains stable across multiple model families, parameter scales, and datasets. These results support a local co-occurrence activation (LCA) account of probe-time CoT, in which the observed gains appear to arise primarily from lexical activation and short-range token co-occurrence rather than sentence-level logical derivation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过探针实验发现，思维链（CoT）提示的增益主要来自词汇激活和短范围（2-3个token）共现，而非句子级别的逻辑推导。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注CoT的生成过程，但对其推理文本中哪些具体属性驱动了准确性提升的理解不足。
AI.method: 通过在推理上下文中固定文本，进行打乱、截断等扰动实验，系统分析不同文本属性对模型答案的影响。
AI.result: 全局乱序推理仍显著优于无CoT基线；保持2-3个连续token即可恢复大部分性能；排除了显式答案复制、语法完整性等替代解释。
AI.conclusion: 提出局部共现激活（LCA）解释：CoT的探针阶段增益主要来自词汇激活和短范围token共现，而非句子级逻辑推导。
idea_en: A method for improving language model accuracy by inserting locally co-occurring token windows (n=2-3) rather than full chain-of-thought rationales.
A probe-time evaluation framework that isolates lexical activation effects from logical ordering effects in chain-of-thought prompting.
A token-level perturbation technique for identifying minimal contiguous token windows that preserve chain-of-thought performance gains.
A local co-occurrence activation (LCA) mechanism for enhancing model reasoning without requiring complete grammatical sentences.
A system for generating compressed rationales by retaining only short-range token adjacency patterns from full chain-of-thought texts.
idea_ch: 一种通过插入局部共现token窗口（n=2-3）而非完整思维链推理文本以提升语言模型准确率的方法
一种隔离思维链提示中词汇激活效应与逻辑排序效应的探针时间评估框架
一种基于token级扰动技术识别保持思维链性能增益的最小连续token窗口的方法
一种无需完整语法句子的局部共现激活（LCA）机制，用于增强模型推理能力
一种从完整思维链文本中仅保留短范围token邻接模式来生成压缩推理文本的系统

title: Helicase: Uncertainty-Guided Supply Chain Knowledge Graph Construction with Autonomous Multi-Agent LLMs
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems have been widely adopted for knowledge retrieval and report generation, synthesizing known information through web search and textual reasoning. However, many critical information tasks in supply chains are not simple one-shot queries: they are structural inference problems requiring multi-hop reasoning across complex, fragmented web resources. Questions such as \textit{``Which Tesla components use lithium from Australian mines?''} have no answer in any single document; answers must be computationally synthesized through the autonomous construction and analysis of dynamic knowledge graphs assembled from fragmented, heterogeneous sources. Moreover, such discovery processes must be uncertainty-aware: decisions depend not only on answers but on calibrated confidence in their reliability, traceable to source quality and reasoning consistency. To address this capability gap, we propose \textit{Helicase}, an autonomous multi-agent LLM system for uncertainty-guided supply chain knowledge graph construction. \textit{Helicase} decomposes high-level supply-chain queries into executable investigation plans, coordinates specialized web-search, reasoning, and coding agents through iterative verification loops, and incrementally constructs query-specific supply chain knowledge graphs with per-fact uncertainty annotations. Its three-layer uncertainty framework tracks uncertainty at the action, trajectory, and memory layers, enabling both structural inference and calibrated confidence assessment. To evaluate autonomous reasoning across the full complexity spectrum, we introduce SCQA (Supply Chain Query Assessment), a benchmark of 80 supply chain queries organized into four quadrants spanning single-hop to multi-hop inference under both high and low data visibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Helicase，一个基于多智能体LLM的自主知识图谱构建系统，用于不确定性引导的供应链推理。该系统将复杂查询分解为可执行调查计划，协调搜索、推理和编码智能体，并通过迭代验证循环逐步构建带有事实级不确定性注释的供应链知识图谱。同时提出了SCQA基准测试集。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM多智能体系统擅长单次查询和简单检索，但无法处理供应链中的结构化推理问题——这些问题需要跨多个碎片化网络资源进行多跳推理，且推理结果必须附带可追溯、可校准的不确定性度量，以支持关键决策。
AI.method: Helicase采用三层不确定性框架（行动层、轨迹层、记忆层），将高层供应链查询分解为可执行调查计划，协调专用网络搜索、推理和编码智能体，通过迭代验证循环逐步构建查询特定的供应链知识图谱，并为每个事实添加不确定性注释。
AI.result: 提出了SCQA基准测试集，包含80个供应链查询，分为四个象限（单跳/多跳推理 × 高/低数据可见性），用于评估供应链推理中不同复杂度级别的自主推理能力。
AI.conclusion: Helicase填补了现有LLM系统在结构化供应链推理中的能力空白，通过不确定性引导的知识图谱构建实现了可追溯、可校准的复杂供应链查询推理，对供应链溯源、风险评估等关键任务具有重要价值。
idea_en: A multi-agent LLM system for autonomous knowledge graph construction guided by uncertainty quantification, where the system decomposes high-level queries into executable investigation plans and incrementally builds query-specific knowledge graphs with per-fact uncertainty annotations.

A three-layer uncertainty tracking framework (action, trajectory, and memory layers) that enables both structural inference across fragmented web sources and calibrated confidence assessment for supply chain reasoning tasks.

An autonomous iterative verification loop mechanism that coordinates specialized web-search, reasoning, and coding agents to construct dynamic knowledge graphs from heterogeneous, fragmented web resources.

A method for traceable uncertainty annotation at the individual fact level within knowledge graphs, where confidence is calibrated based on source quality and reasoning consistency across multi-hop inference chains.

A benchmark design (SCQA) that categorizes supply chain queries into four quadrants based on single-hop vs multi-hop reasoning and high vs low data visibility, providing systematic evaluation across the full complexity spectrum of autonomous supply chain reasoning.
idea_ch: 一种基于不确定性量化的多智能体LLM自主知识图谱构建系统，将高层查询分解为可执行调查计划，并逐步构建带有事实级不确定性注释的查询特定知识图谱。
三层不确定性追踪框架（行动层、轨迹层、记忆层），支持跨碎片化网络资源的结构化推理，并为供应链推理任务提供可校准的置信度评估。
一种自主迭代验证循环机制，协调专用网络搜索、推理和编码智能体，从异构碎片化网络资源中构建动态知识图谱。
一种知识图谱中单个事实级别的可追溯不确定性注释方法，基于源质量和跨多跳推理链的推理一致性来校准置信度。
一种SCQA基准测试设计方法，将供应链查询按单跳/多跳推理和高/低数据可见性分为四个象限，为自主供应链推理提供全复杂度谱系的系统评估。

title: Multi-Stakeholder LLM Alignment: Decomposing Estimation from Aggregation
summary: Multi-stakeholder tasks require one output to satisfy users with conflicting preferences. Holistic LLM judges conflate utility estimation and utility aggregation, yielding unstable implicit weights. We show empirically and theoretically that this aggregation-specific \emph{weighting noise} can create large score shifts when stakeholder satisfaction is dispersed; in our experiments, these weight-induced shifts also increase with stakeholder count. We propose \textsc{DecompR}: counterfactual-calibrated weights are fixed from query structure before candidate scoring, while per-role utilities are estimated independently, removing candidate-dependent weight drift and reducing estimation noise.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DecompR方法，通过反事实校准权重和独立估计各角色效用，解决多利益相关者任务中LLM评估者的权重噪声问题。
AI.motivation: 多利益相关者任务需要输出满足具有冲突偏好的用户。整体式LLM评估者将效用估计和效用聚合混为一谈，产生不稳定的隐式权重，导致评分偏差。
AI.method: 提出DecompR方法：从查询结构固定反事实校准权重，独立估计每个角色的效用，消除候选依赖的权重漂移并减少估计噪声。
AI.result: 实验证明加权噪声在利益相关者满意度分散时会产生大的分数偏移，且这种偏移随利益相关者数量增加而增大。
AI.conclusion: DecompR通过解耦效用估计和聚合过程，提高了多利益相关者任务评估的稳定性和准确性。
idea_en: A method for multi-stakeholder task evaluation using counterfactual-calibrated weights fixed from query structure before candidate scoring, with per-role utilities estimated independently.
A system that reduces weighting noise in LLM-based holistic judges by decoupling utility estimation from utility aggregation in multi-stakeholder scenarios.
A technique for eliminating candidate-dependent weight drift in preference aggregation by pre-fixing weights based on query structure analysis.
idea_ch: 一种基于反事实校准权重的多利益相关者任务评估方法，在候选评分前从查询结构固定权重，并独立估计每个角色的效用。
一种在LLM整体评估中减少加权噪声的系统，通过解耦多利益相关者场景中的效用估计与效用聚合。
一种通过基于查询结构分析预固定权重来消除偏好聚合中候选依赖的权重漂移的技术。

title: On the Detection of Commutative Factors in Factor Graphs: Necessary and Sufficient Conditions
summary: Exploiting the indistinguishability of objects in a probabilistic graphical model such as a factor graph is key to lifted probabilistic inference algorithms and allows for tractable probabilistic inference problems with respect to domain sizes. A central building block for the exploitation of indistinguishable objects in factor graphs is the identification of commutative factors, i.e., factors whose output values are invariant under permutations of input values assigned to a subset of their arguments. In this paper, we revisit the theoretical foundations underlying the state-of-the-art algorithm to detect commutative factors. Specifically, we show that in its current form, the state-of-the-art algorithm relies on a central theorem that is mistakenly regarded as a sufficient condition to identify commutative factors, while it actually only implies necessary condition. Consequently, the state of the art might, as we show in this paper, deliver incorrect results. To fix the flaws currently present in the state of the art, we prove a slightly modified version of the aforementioned theorem, which serves as a necessary condition to identify commutative factors. Moreover, we present a corrected version of the state-of-the-art algorithm, which keeps its efficiency while ensuring correctness and introduce a complementary algorithm with tighter worst-case bounds.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了当前最先进的交换因子检测算法存在理论基础缺陷（将必要条件误当作充分条件），并提出了修正后的算法及其补充算法。
AI.motivation: 提升概率图模型中可交换因子的检测准确性，这是实现提升概率推理（lifted probabilistic inference）的关键构建模块。
AI.method: 1）指出原定理被错误地视为充分条件，实则仅为必要条件；2）证明修正后的定理版本作为识别交换因子的必要条件；3）提出修正版算法保持原效率且保证正确性；4）设计一个具有更紧最坏情况界的新补充算法。
AI.result: 原SOTA算法可能因理论缺陷给出错误结果；修正后算法在保证正确性的同时维持了原有计算效率。
AI.conclusion: 通过修正理论基础和算法设计，实现了交换因子检测的准确性和效率的兼顾，为提升概率推理提供了更可靠的基础。
idea_en: A method for detecting commutative factors in factor graphs using a corrected necessary condition theorem that avoids false positives from the prior mistaken sufficiency condition.
A corrected version of the state-of-the-art commutative factor detection algorithm that maintains computational efficiency while ensuring correctness.
A complementary algorithm for detecting commutative factors with tighter worst-case complexity bounds compared to existing approaches.
A systematic approach to distinguishing necessary vs. sufficient conditions in probabilistic graphical model factor analysis.
idea_ch: 一种基于修正的必要条件定理的因子图中交换因子检测方法，避免原误当作充分条件导致的误检测。
一种保持计算效率同时保证正确性的SOTA交换因子检测算法修正版本。
一种具有更紧最坏情况复杂度界的交换因子检测补充算法。
一种区分概率图模型中因子分析的必要条件与充分条件的系统性方法。

title: TADDLE: A Tool-Augmented Agent for Detecting Deficient LLM-Generated Peer Reviews
summary: LLM-generated peer reviews are increasingly common at major venues, yet their deficiencies are hard to detect because they are uniformly fluent and well-structured. Existing work either classifies authorship without judging quality, or scores quality with features designed for human-written reviews; no prior system detects deficiencies in LLM-generated reviews at the level of individual defect types. To bridge the gap, we introduce TADDLE, a Tool-Augmented Agent for Detecting Deficient LLM-Generated Peer Reviews, together with the first expert-annotated benchmark for this task. Our benchmark comprises 1,800 reviews on 50 ICLR 2025 papers, multi-label-annotated by 18 domain experts against a taxonomy of six defect categories (plus a non-deficient label). TADDLE decomposes detection into four specialized analysis tools -- Verify, Correct, Complete, and Transform -- orchestrated by an agent; an integrator synthesizes their outputs into binary and multi-label classifications via two-stage semi-supervised learning. Extensive experiments show that TADDLE performs strongly on both binary detection and the multi-label classification task. We release the benchmark and code at https://github.com/AquariusAQ/TADDLE.

AI.tldr: 提出TADDLE系统，通过工具增强型智能体检测LLM生成的同行评审中的六类缺陷，并构建了首个专家标注基准数据集。
AI.motivation: LLM生成的同行评审日益普遍，但其缺陷难以被察觉，现有工作要么仅分类作者身份而不评判质量，要么针对人类撰写的评审设计评分特征，缺乏在单个缺陷类型层面检测LLM生成评审缺陷的系统。
AI.method: TADDLE将缺陷检测分解为四个专门分析工具（Verify验证、Correct纠正、Complete补全、Transform转换），由智能体编排，并通过两阶段半监督学习集成多工具输出，实现二分类和多标签分类。
AI.result: 在包含1800条评审（覆盖50篇ICLR 2025论文，由18名领域专家进行六类缺陷多标签标注）的基准上，TADDLE在二分类检测和多标签分类任务上均表现强劲。
AI.conclusion: TADDLE有效填补了LLM生成同行评审缺陷细粒度检测的空白，提供了可复现的基准和方法。
idea_en: Agent-orchestrated multi-tool analysis framework for detecting defects in LLM-generated peer reviews using four specialized tools (Verify, Correct, Complete, Transform).
Two-stage semi-supervised learning integrator that synthesizes outputs from multiple analysis tools into binary and multi-label defect classifications.
Expert-annotated benchmark dataset of 1,800 reviews with multi-label annotations across six defect categories (plus non-deficient label) for LLM-generated peer review quality assessment.
Taxonomy of six defect categories specifically designed for characterizing deficiencies in LLM-generated peer reviews.
idea_ch: 一种基于智能体编排的多工具分析框架，通过四个专门分析工具（验证、纠正、补全、转换）协同检测LLM生成同行评审中的缺陷。
两阶段半监督学习集成器，将多个分析工具的输出合成为二分类和多标签缺陷分类结果。
包含1800条评审的专家标注基准数据集，针对LLM生成同行评审质量评估，覆盖六类缺陷类别（外加非缺陷标签）的多标签标注。
专门用于刻画LLM生成同行评审缺陷的六类缺陷分类体系。

title: From Norms to Indicators (N2I-RAG): An Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation Framework for Legal Indicator Computation
summary: Computing legal indicators from normative texts is a key task in legal monitoring and policy evaluation, but presents significant challenges due to the complexity, scale, and interpretive nature of legal language, as well as the variability in available document quality. Existing natural language processing techniques and generative models can assist in legal analysis, but often suffer from high risk of hallucinations and lack the interpretability and evidence grounding required for reliable indicator computation. This paper presents N2I-RAG (From Norms to Indicators), an agentic retrieval-augmented generation framework designed to automate the computation of legal indicators in a transparent and traceable way. We integrate adaptive retrieval, llm-based agents, and validation mechanisms in a modular pipeline, where each component performs a defined role in filtering, retrieving, and assessing evidence, and in producing binary legal outcomes linked to identifiable legal provisions. The framework emphasizes traceability by requiring explicit explanations of intermediate decisions and final indicator assignments. We evaluate N2I-RAG using an in-house constructed French marine environmental law corpus that includes both scanned and digital sources. Comparative experiments with multiple language model families demonstrate that the proposed approach consistently outperforms baseline systems, and generalizes well when tested on 2 different bans. The results indicate that agentic retrieval-augmented generation can bridge open-text legal language and standardized indicator computation, offering a foundation for transparent and scalable legal observatories.

AI.tldr: 本文提出N2I-RAG框架，一种基于智能体检索增强生成的方法，用于从规范性法律文本中自动、透明、可追溯地计算法律指标，并在法国海洋环境法语料库上验证了其优越性。
AI.motivation: 法律指标计算面临法律语言复杂、规模大、解释性强、文档质量不一等挑战，现有NLP和生成模型存在高幻觉风险且缺乏可解释性和证据基础，亟需一种透明可追溯的自动化方案。
AI.method: 提出N2I-RAG框架，采用智能体检索增强生成架构，集成了自适应检索、基于LLM的智能体以及验证机制，构建模块化流水线：各组件分别执行证据过滤、检索、评估，产生链接到具体法律条款的二元法律结果，并要求对中间决策和最终指标分配提供显式解释。
AI.result: 在自建法国海洋环境法律语料库（含扫描件和数字源）上，与多个语言模型家族进行对比实验，N2I-RAG持续优于基线系统，并在2种不同的禁令测试上展现出良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 智能体检索增强生成能够弥合开放文本法律语言与标准化指标计算之间的鸿沟，为构建透明可扩展的法律观测站奠定基础。
idea_en: Adaptive retrieval mechanism for legal indicator computation that dynamically adjusts retrieval scope based on query complexity and document quality variability.
Agentic RAG pipeline with modular components for evidence filtering, retrieval, and assessment, where each module produces explicit intermediate explanations linked to identifiable legal provisions.
Validation mechanism integrated within legal indicator computation framework that cross-checks LLM-generated outputs against retrieved legal evidence to reduce hallucination risk.
Binary legal outcome generation system with traceable chain-of-thought explanations connecting each output to specific normative text provisions.
Multi-source document processing pipeline capable of handling both scanned (OCR) and born-digital legal documents within a unified indicator computation framework.
idea_ch: 面向法律指标计算的自适应检索机制，可根据查询复杂度和文档质量动态调整检索范围。
基于智能体RAG的模块化流水线，各组件分别执行证据过滤、检索和评估，并生成链接到具体法律条款的显式中间解释。
集成在法律指标计算框架中的验证机制，通过将LLM输出与检索到的法律证据交叉校验来降低幻觉风险。
可追溯的链式推理二元法律结果生成系统，将每个输出与特定规范性文本条款相连接。
统一指标计算框架下的多源文档处理流水线，能够同时处理扫描件（OCR）和原生数字法律文档。

title: Developing a Totally Unimodular Linear Program for Optimal Conformance Checking: When and Why It Complements A*
comment: Author-accepted manuscript accepted for publication in Expert Systems with Applications. Code and experiment scripts are available at: https://github.com/Izack-Cohen/unimodular-conformance-checking. Version corresponding to the accepted paper: v1.0.0
summary:
Alignment-based conformance checking is the state-of-the-art approach for comparing observed process executions with normative process models. The standard exact solution relies on an A*-based heuristic search, which can exhibit exponential runtime in the presence of long traces or substantial deviations.
  This paper introduces a reformulation of alignment-based conformance checking as a totally unimodular linear program (LP) defined on the reachability graph of the synchronous product. By exploiting the underlying network-flow structure, the proposed formulation guarantees the existence of an integral optimal extreme-point solution through LP relaxation, thereby avoiding the combinatorial overhead associated with integer variables and branch-and-bound search.
  We conduct an extensive empirical evaluation on more than 2.1 million conformance checking instances derived from real-world and synthetic benchmark datasets. The results show that A* and the LP approach exhibit complementary performance characteristics: the former performs best on short, well-conforming traces, while the LP formulation provides substantial speedups for longer traces with deviations, precisely where conformance checking is most informative. Based on these findings, we derive simple algorithm-selection guidelines that combine both approaches, achieving average runtime savings of 38.6% with 96% selection accuracy compared to always using A*.

AI.tldr: 本文将对齐一致性检测重新表述为基于可达图的全幺模线性规划问题，利用网络流结构保证整数最优解，并提出了结合A*与LP的算法选择策略，在210万个实例上实现平均38.6%的运行时节省。
AI.motivation: 传统基于A*的对齐一致性检测方法在面对长轨迹或较大偏差时存在指数级运行时间问题，亟需更高效的求解方案。
AI.method: 将对齐一致性检测重新表述为定义在同步乘积可达图上的全幺模线性规划(LP)问题，利用底层网络流结构保证LP松弛后存在整数最优极值点解，避免整数变量和分支定界搜索的组合开销。
AI.result: 在超过210万个实例上的实验表明，A*在短且符合规范的轨迹上表现最佳，而LP公式在处理较长轨迹和偏差时提供了显著的加速效果。结合两者的简单算法选择策略实现平均38.6%的运行时节省，选择准确率达96%。
AI.conclusion: 通过全幺模LP重新表述对齐一致性检测是可行且高效的，两种方法具有互补特性，结合使用可显著提升整体性能。
idea_en: Reformulation of alignment-based conformance checking as a totally unimodular linear program on the reachability graph of the synchronous product, guaranteeing integral optimal extreme-point solutions through LP relaxation without integer variables.

Algorithm-selection framework that combines A* heuristic search and LP-based conformance checking, dynamically choosing the optimal approach based on trace characteristics to achieve average 38.6% runtime savings.
Network-flow structure exploitation in the synchronous product reachability graph for conformance checking, eliminating combinatorial overhead of branch-and-bound search.
idea_ch: 基于同步乘积可达图的全幺模线性规划对齐一致性检测方法，通过LP松弛保证整数最优极值点解，无需整数变量和分支定界搜索
结合A*启发式搜索与LP公式的算法选择框架，根据轨迹特征动态选择最优检测方法，平均节省38.6%运行时间
利用同步乘积可达图中的网络流结构进行一致性检测，消除组合搜索开销的技术方案

title: Neuro-Symbolic Verification of LLM Outputs for Data-Sensitive Domains (extended preprint)
comment: Extended preprint version of accepted technical communication at KI 2026. 22 pages, 3 figures
summary: LLMs deployed in high-stakes domains face fundamental reliability challenges: hallucinations, inconsistencies, and privacy vulnerabilities introduce unacceptable risks where errors carry legal, financial, or safety consequences. This paper presents a hybrid verification architecture combining formal symbolic methods with neural semantic analysis to provide complementary guarantees for LLM-generated content. This architecture employs logical reasoning for input verification, leveraging completeness properties to provide decidable guarantees on structured requirements. For output validation, embedding-based semantic similarity detects contextual hallucinations where formal methods lack expressiveness. This separation is realized in a parallel, actor-based pipeline, addressing limitations of prompt-based self-verification approaches, which inherit the distributional biases that produce hallucinations. The proposed architecture and type-aware verification method are validated with HAIMEDA, a real-world medical device damage assessment reporting system developed through Action Design Research. Evaluation shows hallucination detection rates of over 83% for structured entities and 72% for semantic fabrications, with a 30% reduction in report creation time, demonstrating that neuro-symbolic architectures can provide principled safeguards for LLM deployment in data-sensitive domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种混合验证架构，结合形式化符号方法与神经语义分析，用于检测LLM生成内容中的幻觉、不一致和隐私漏洞问题，在医疗设备损伤评估报告系统中验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 高安全领域部署的LLM存在幻觉、不一致和隐私漏洞等根本性可靠性问题，这些错误在涉及法律、财务或安全后果的场景中带来不可接受的风险。
AI.method: 提出混合验证架构：1) 输入验证使用形式化符号方法（逻辑推理），利用完备性属性提供结构化需求的可判定保证；2) 输出验证使用基于嵌入的语义相似性检测上下文幻觉；3) 采用并行的、基于actor的流水线架构实现分离验证，克服提示式自验证方法继承分布偏差的局限。
AI.result: 在医疗设备损伤评估报告系统HAIMEDA中验证：结构化实体幻觉检测率超过83%，语义虚构检测率72%，报告创建时间减少30%。
AI.conclusion: 神经符号架构能够为数据敏感领域中LLM的部署提供有原则的安全保障。
idea_en: A hybrid verification architecture combining formal symbolic methods (logical reasoning with completeness guarantees) and neural semantic analysis (embedding-based similarity) for LLM-generated content in high-stakes domains
A parallel actor-based pipeline design for input verification and output validation that separates formal and neural methods to avoid distributional biases inherited by prompt-based self-verification

Type-aware verification method that uses logical reasoning for structured requirements verification leveraging completeness properties, while using embedding-based semantic similarity for detecting contextual hallucinations
A neuro-symbolic safeguard system deployed in medical device damage assessment reporting (HAIMEDA) achieving over 83% hallucination detection for structured entities and 72% for semantic fabrications
idea_ch: 一种混合验证架构，结合形式化符号方法（具有完备性保证的逻辑推理）与神经语义分析（基于嵌入的相似度），用于高安全领域LLM生成内容的验证

title: LELA: An End-to-end LLM-based Entity Linking Framework with Zero-shot Domain Adaptation
summary: Entity linking is a key component of many downstream NLP systems, yet existing approaches are often tied to the specific target knowledge bases and domains, limiting their real world application. In this paper, we extend LELA, a modular and domain-agnostic LLM-based entity disambiguation method, into a practical Python library that integrates zero-shot Named Entity Recognition (NER) -thereby providing a complete end-toend pipeline for entity-linking in real-world usage. We provide experimental results validating LELA's performance and robustness across diverse entity linking settings. In our demo, users can play with the system on their own input texts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了LELA，一个基于LLM的模块化、领域无关的实体消歧方法，并将其扩展为实用的Python库，集成了零样本NER，形成完整的端到端实体链接流水线。
AI.motivation: 现有实体链接方法通常依赖于特定知识库和领域，限制了实际应用中的泛化能力，缺乏模块化、领域无关且可实际部署的解决方案。
AI.method: 将LELA（基于LLM的模块化实体消歧方法）扩展为Python库，并集成零样本NER组件，构建完整的端到端实体链接流水线。
AI.result: 实验验证了LELA在多种实体链接场景下的性能和鲁棒性，用户可通过Demo测试自有文本。
AI.conclusion: LELA作为一种模块化、领域无关的LLM实体链接方案，具备良好的实际部署潜力，零样本NER的集成进一步提升了其实用性。
idea_en: A modular LLM-based entity disambiguation method that is domain-agnostic and does not require retraining for different knowledge bases.

title: Generating Robust Portfolios of Optimization Models using Large Language Models
comment: Accepted at the ICML 2026 LM4Plan Workshop
summary: Mathematical optimization is a powerful tool for structured decision-making across domains such as resource allocation and planning. Formulating optimization models faithful to reality, though, remains a significant bottleneck as it typically demands both domain expertise and optimization knowledge that are often scarce. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) promise to bridge this gap, enabling the generation of candidate optimization models from natural language descriptions. However, there is no guarantee that any single LLM-generated model is reliable, and existing approaches that output only one model are therefore risky. In this work, we propose a novel algorithm that generates a portfolio of optimization models, designed to be robust to the limitations of LLMs. Our method exploits the observation that a single LLM can play two distinct roles $\unicode{x2014}$ as a stochastic generator and as a reasoning evaluator $\unicode{x2014}$ and proposes a unified framework that leverages both capabilities in a complementary manner. We provide theoretical guarantees showing that, as long as either the generator or the evaluator is well-aligned with human preferences, the portfolio is guaranteed to contain high-quality candidates, enabling a principled human-in-the-loop process in which a decision-maker can review multiple candidates before committing to one. We further validate our approach empirically, demonstrating strong performance across a range of optimization modeling tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出一种利用LLM同时作为随机生成器和推理评估器来生成优化模型组合的算法，确保至少有一个高质量候选模型，实现人机协同的优化建模。
AI.motivation: 传统优化建模需要领域专家和优化知识，门槛高；现有LLM生成单个优化模型不可靠，存在风险。
AI.method: 让同一个LLM扮演两个角色：作为随机生成器生成多个候选优化模型，同时作为推理评估器评估这些模型的质量，形成一个统一的框架。通过理论保证，只要生成器或评估器中至少一个与人类偏好对齐，组合中就能包含高质量候选模型。
AI.result: 在多种优化建模任务上表现出色，验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过LLM的双重角色（生成+评估）构建模型组合，能有效提升优化建模的可靠性，支持人机协同决策。
idea_en: A method for generating a portfolio of optimization models using a single LLM in dual roles as stochastic generator and reasoning evaluator, with theoretical guarantee of containing high-quality candidates.
A human-in-the-loop optimization model selection framework where decision-makers review multiple LLM-generated candidates before committing to one.
A unified framework leveraging LLM's complementary capabilities of stochastic generation and reasoning evaluation for robust optimization modeling.
An algorithm that uses LLM's self-consistency by having the same model both generate and evaluate optimization models, ensuring portfolio quality.

title: ORCA: An End-to-End Interactive Copilot for Optimized Root Cause Analysis
summary: Causal analysis is a crucial task in many domains, including manufacturing, social science, and medicine. However, despite recent progress, the conceptual and methodological complexity of causal methods makes them largely inaccessible to domain experts. This gap prevents experts from leveraging these advances and hinders researchers who lack access to real-world data for validation. To bridge this divide, we introduce ORCA, a copilot for end-to-end causal analysis. ORCA orchestrates agents to understand the user's goals and guide them through the most appropriate causal analysis workflow, from fully automatic to highly user-guided execution. It features causal discovery, causal effect estimation, explainability and Root-Cause-Analysis (RCA). ORCA evaluates and compares performance, generates key metrics and diagrams, and generates insights through structured reports. We highlight its effectiveness across several real-world use-cases.

AI.tldr: ORCA是一个端到端因果分析副驾驶系统，通过编排多个智能体来引导用户完成因果分析工作流程，涵盖因果发现、效应估计、可解释性和根因分析，并能自动生成评估报告。
AI.motivation: 因果分析方法在概念和方法上过于复杂，领域专家难以使用；研究者缺乏真实世界数据进行方法验证。
AI.method: ORCA通过编排多个智能体（agents），理解用户目标，引导用户选择最合适的因果分析工作流，支持从全自动到高度用户引导的执行模式，集成因果发现、因果效应估计、可解释性和根因分析等功能。
AI.result: 在多个真实世界用例中展示了有效性，能够评估和比较性能、生成关键指标和图表、并通过结构化报告生成洞察。
AI.conclusion: ORCA成功弥合了因果分析方法与领域专家之间的鸿沟，使因果分析变得可及可用。

title: Boosting Knowledge Graph Foundation Models via Enhanced Negative Sampling
summary: Knowledge graphs (KGs) have become the core backbone of numerous downstream tasks such as question answering and recommender systems. However, despite all this, KGs are often very incomplete. To perform zero-shot knowledge graph completion in unseen KGs, which have different relational vocabularies from those used for pre-training, KG foundation models (KGFMs) receive a wide range of attention. Existing KGFMs often perform training using random negative triples, which are constructed by replacing the head or tail entity of a positive triple with a random entity. However, these negative triples are often constructed with limited quality, providing weak supervision for KGFM training. In this paper, we propose a simple yet effective adaptive negative sampling approach, KMAS, to enhance existing KGFMs. KMAS constructs hard negative triples through the updated relation embeddings generated from the existing KGFM's relation encoder. To further adaptively align with the evolving capability of the KGFM during the training process, KMAS adjusts the ratio of hard negative triples dynamically throughout the whole training process: after a warmup phrase, it increases the ratio linearly and then decreases linearly. Extensive experiments are conducted over 44 data sets. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed negative sampling method can enhance many SOTA KGFMs without requiring excessive additional time or memory consumption.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KMAS，一种自适应负采样方法，通过构造硬负三元组并动态调整其比例，增强知识图谱基础模型（KGFM）的零样本知识图谱补全能力，在44个数据集上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有KGFM训练使用随机负三元组，质量有限，提供的监督信号弱，限制了模型性能。
AI.method: KMAS方法：1) 利用KGFM关系编码器更新的关系嵌入构造硬负三元组；2) 在整个训练过程中动态调整硬负三元组的比例——预热阶段后先线性增加再线性减少，以自适应对齐模型能力演化。
AI.result: 在44个数据集上的实验表明，KMAS能增强多种SOTA KGFM，且无需过多额外时间和内存开销。
AI.conclusion: 简单的自适应负采样策略能有效提升KGFM的训练质量，为知识图谱补全提供更好的监督信号。
idea_en: Hard negative sampling method for KG foundation models using updated relation embeddings from the relation encoder.
Adaptive ratio adjustment mechanism for hard negative triples that dynamically aligns with the evolving capability of the model during training.
Warmup-then-linear-increase-then-linear-decrease scheduling strategy for hard negative ratio in KGFM training.
Zero-shot knowledge graph completion enhancement method that improves existing KGFMs without significant extra computational cost.

title: BatteryMFormer: Multi-level Learning for Battery Degradation Trajectory Forecasting
summary: Early battery degradation trajectory forecasting (BDTF), which predicts the full-life state-of-health trajectory from early operational data, is critical for battery optimization, manufacturing, and deployment. Battery degradation data exhibit two key characteristics. First, degradation data present a multi-level structure, including regularities shared within aging conditions and trajectory patterns shared across batteries. Second, degradation-related variations in voltage-current profiles are often localized to specific state-of-charge (SOC) intervals. Existing approaches often fail to explicitly model these characteristics. To bridge this gap, we propose BatteryMFormer, a multi-level Transformer for early BDTF. BatteryMFormer integrates (1) an aging-condition-aware decoder that injects aging-condition priors via aging-condition-informed queries and aging-condition-aware attention, (2) a meta degradation pattern memory that learns and retrieves trajectory prototypes to guide long-horizon forecasting, and (3) a dual-view encoder that jointly captures temporal dynamics and SOC-localized variations from voltage and current time series. Extensive experiments on four battery domains show that BatteryMFormer consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, marking a significant step toward reliable BDTF. Our code is available at https://github.com/Ruifeng-Tan/BatteryMFormer.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为BatteryMFormer的多层级Transformer模型，用于从早期运行数据预测电池全生命周期健康状态退化轨迹，通过建模多层级结构和SOC局部化变化来提升预测精度。
AI.motivation: 电池退化数据具有两个关键特征：一是多层级结构（老化条件间的共享规律和电池间的轨迹模式），二是退化相关变化集中在特定SOC区间。现有方法未能显式建模这些特征。
AI.method: BatteryMFormer包含三个核心模块：(1) 老化条件感知解码器，通过老化条件查询和注意力机制注入先验；(2) 元退化模式记忆模块，学习并检索轨迹原型以指导长期预测；(3) 双视角编码器，联合捕捉时间动态和SOC局部化变化。
AI.result: 在四个电池领域的实验表明，BatteryMFormer一致优于现有最先进基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为可靠的电池早期退化轨迹预测迈出了重要一步，代码已开源。
idea_en: A multi-level Transformer architecture for battery degradation trajectory forecasting that explicitly models aging-condition shared regularities and battery-specific trajectory patterns.
An aging-condition-aware decoder using condition-informed queries and condition-aware attention to inject aging priors into the forecasting process.
A meta degradation pattern memory module that learns and retrieves trajectory prototypes to guide long-horizon battery health prediction.
A dual-view encoder jointly capturing temporal dynamics and SOC-localized variations from voltage-current time series for comprehensive feature extraction.
A method for identifying degradation-relevant localized variations in specific state-of-charge (SOC) intervals from voltage and current profiles.
